answer: Tie each agent's standing to a non-transferable wharf-berth bond anchored to one scarce hardware key, earned only when several already-established peers from separate funding clusters co-sign audited work-receipts. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single funding root, so its endorsements echo back onto themselves and never span distinct clusters, leaving its trust map a flat atlas sketch with no real depth. An honest node posts one anchor; a farm must buy a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head, cost rising linearly with every clone.
